plan.source: the source: Seekhat Yol: Seekhat Yol (King of the Murkmire): an Argonian village of pale reed-thatched stilt houses on platforms round its Hist, the closest match to the record's look; its seven rooms, topped up with three of Alten Meerhleel's (King of the Murkmire) rooms (market, bunkhouse, dockmaster's house), house the town's nine households and its jetty market. Cormaris (the allocated source) was Imperial and Dunmer and needed every house replaced
